searchText: Does anyone know of any projects that make it easy to give an ETH bounty to a GitHub project? Something that makes it so the repository owner can claim the bounty, but it doesn't require manual coordination with the owner? I'm OK with a trusted or semi-trusted solution. I want something where I can drop a bounty amount + link to details in a GitHub issue as a way of saying, "I pledge X ETH if you fix this bug" and ideally the bounty system provides the GitHub app author with details on how they can claim the bounty. This would be for GitHub repositories where I generally trust the authors to not frivolously claim the bounty, so doesn't need any security beyond some mechanism that allows the GitHub repository owner to claim it but not random issue followers. As <@!203220829473996800> mentioned, it is due to the issuance on eth2. The number being reported by the Launchpad is the sum(balances), it should be the sum(effective_balances). I'll look into fixing that, thanks <@!128318700754436096> <https://gitcoin.co/bounties/funder> ? 😄 That is close, but not quite. It is for the project owner to fund work from external sources. I am an external funder and I want to fund the project owner to prioritize my issue over others. aren't they going to do that naturally if the bounty is high and expires in x days? Since I'm not the repo owner, I cannot create a bounty for their project using GitCoin IIUC. Only repository owners can create GitCoin bounties on projects. brave browser has this github tipping feature thing but its 💩 I don't want a tip so mach as I want to signal to the developers of a particular repository my willingness to pay for an issue being resolved and, ideally, have that auto-payout once the issue is fixed within some time frame I set and if not then it would be sent back to me. A big part of this is providing the GitHub owner information on how they can "claim" the payment as well. I'm hoping for something that is well integrated into GitHub and doesn't require *me* to onboard the project owner to Ethereum. whats wrong with posting a comment under the issue saying you're prepared to pay X to see it implemented? would be a nice side feature for gitcoin to offer perhaps, that way it gets more dev eyes on it and other people who might be willing to pool-in for that feature gitcoinbot would post comment on the issue on github saying something like "<@301186049323958275> has offered 3.14ETH on gitcoin to see this implemented" "pico has added 0.1 ETH to this bounty" etc yell at @owocki on twitter 😄 I'm still boycotting Twitter. 😬 I *could* just post saying I'll send ETH if implemented, but then I'll be expected to onboard the user. I am hoping for something that handles the whole thing and I can just set aside the money. I do one transaction today and the rest of the process is handled for me. <@!301186049323958275> have you seen tip4commit.com? That seems like a really bad way to go about things... 😬 Encourages lots of commits, rather than effective commits. I suppose the idea is that the repository maintainer is in charge of accepting, and generally smaller PRs are better. 🤔 Anyway, not what I'm looking for. I specifically want one issue fixed that has been open for a long time. there's also Bountysource <@!378595508748550145>what do you think? Good feature to have? Doesn't support crypto it appears. 0.25 ETH https://www.bountysource.com/issues/3992780-proposal-import-from-document-editor Oh, neat. 👀
